findings.location: scripts/run_events.py to_otel/_operation_error (the AGENT_INVOKE END, projected as the plain delegate span); README OTel mapping (status bullet, Delegations bullet)
findings.finding: With R2-3's binding, a delegation's outcome follows from its child run's: it is OK exactly when the child COMPLETED. _operation_error still marks the delegate span ERROR on any non-OK outcome, so its status repeats the child's or contradicts it. In the team projection, the failed w2 delegation is two error spans: delegate ERROR FAIL and invoke_agent ERROR FAILED (P92). When the child run is HANDED_OFF, its invoke_agent span is UNSET ('ended as designed'), but the delegate span, which the binding forces to a non-OK outcome, is ERROR FAIL (P93). The README avoids counting agent invocations twice and says a hand-off is not an error; error counts across spans do not yet follow either point. No derived vector log has a failed delegation (P91).
findings.requiredChange: Optionally leave the delegate span's status UNSET (the child invoke_agent span carries the outcome), or state in the README that a failed or handed-off delegation also marks its delegate span as an error.

dispositions.evidence: derive_log refuses DERIVATION for a gate whose subject is a HOOK or HANDOFF step (by_id kind check) and for any emitted time above 2^53 - 1 ms (in emit). My V021 hook-gate trace passes MAS-RA-008 and is refused DERIVATION by derive_log (P30). New vector R040 (the derived V021 log naming the builder's hook-gated trace) gives DERIVATION (P90) and is isolated (passes with DERIVATION disabled). The 10^13 s step is refused DERIVATION (P70). Gates on a GATE or a DELEGATE step still derive and pass (P72, P73). The README and docstring state the three preconditions, and 36 of 36 valid traces still derive and pass (P50).

RUN_SCOPE (done_before) requires the subject's and the revised span's END to come earlier in the sequence than the verification's or revision's START, in the same run. P31, P32, P33 and P34 are now RUN_SCOPE, and new vector R027 (a verification of its own open run span) is RUN_SCOPE and isolated. The order is by sequence only, as stated in Not claimed. I confirmed the reason: in the 36 derived logs, 24 verifications start before their subject ends in time (for example V044: 60000 ms against 66000 ms; P74), so a time rule would refuse valid derived logs. A verification after its subject in the sequence but earlier in time is accepted, as stated (P75). Revision targets: an ended AGENT_INVOKE of the same run may be revised (P84), an open one or another run's may not (P85, P83). Every derived log still satisfies the rule (P51: 0 and 0).

RUN_SCOPE binds each AGENT_INVOKE END to its child RUN END: OK exactly when the child COMPLETED, with the same outputHash, payloadRef and tokens. P36 (OK with output over a FAILED child) and P37 (tokens 99, also vector R028, isolated) are RUN_SCOPE. Further probes: FAIL over a COMPLETED child (P77), the same digest in another store (P78), and OK without output (P79) are RUN_SCOPE. UNKNOWN over a FAILED child is accepted (P76). All derived logs satisfy the binding by MAS-RA-008's TOTALS_MISMATCH, and all 36 pass. The README's RUN_SCOPE text matches the code. A consequence for the OTel status is NOTE R3-1.

MESSAGE_PAIRING requires the send's timeMs to be no later than the receive's. P35 (receive at 1000 ms, send at 3200 ms) and P82 (1 ms early) are MESSAGE_PAIRING, and an equal time is accepted (P81). New vector R035 (receive at 3100 ms) is isolated. The README rule text says 'no later in time'.

The README list of fields left to the trace now names the profile digest, the terminal reason (P63), the error-trace digest of non-gate steps, a tool call's timeout, limits and sandbox-profile digest, and a delegation's child trace digest. The attributes row states that a run's tokens and cost are inclusive. Point event names are described as 'planeon.' plus the operation in lower case, matching OTEL_POINT_EVENTS.

_operation_error marks ERROR only for a step ending FAIL, ERROR or UNKNOWN (a verification only on ERROR) and a run ending FAILED or ABORTED. P62: the derived V022 HANDED_OFF root and the team's FAIL verify span are UNSET. P86 and P87: the team's verify spans are UNSET, V043's ERRORed gate is an ERROR verify span, and V024's ABORTED root is ERROR. The pinned projections differ from round 2 only in status and error.type (P88). The README bullet matches. The delegate span's status is NOTE R3-1.
